notes.title: More Destruction!
notes.notes:
A new patch is live today with some small adjustments to the gameplay that will bring massive changes to the destruction. 

We have updated our alien plasma and laser blasers with CB556-114 cool-down technology. 
- Main weapon overheating cool-down duration is shorter
- Main weapon cool-down now happens much faster when not holding the triggers


Since each planet has a new defense type and strategy, we have added a defense information window that displays at the start of each new planet. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31522786/a506ba6b0fc8b662ea6e5dcd116f19c4996801ef.png[/img]

notes.title: 3rd Week is a Charm!
notes.notes:
Day of Destruction was released on January 17, 2018. This means we are now in the third week of release! 

Thanks to everyone who has played the game so far. If you haven't already done so, why not jump on the community boards and show some love?

Got some suggestions? We are listening and we are already planning improvements for future releases.


And don't forget tpo tell your friends!

notes.title: Welcome to the invasion!
notes.notes:
Day of Destruction is now available! 

Thanks to everyone who has given feedback, written reviews, and posted gameplay videos. This stuff really helps a small developer like us get the word out. We are excited to see a community forming around this game. 

We would love to hear feedback from everyone on how we can improve your destructive experience. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31522786/b8f2d2f898b5690500dfbdd429360f8a2cd9ee0c.png[/img]
